title: Uploaded training certificate missing from binder
content: Check the upload receipt, document processing status, study assignment, and binder filters. A processing delay is one possible cause. If processing remains pending for 15 minutes, draft an engineering escalation with the document ID and upload timestamp. Do not alter the document.

title: Monitor cannot access a study
content: Verify the monitor identity, invitation acceptance, study assignment, and access expiration. Ask an authorized administrator to review permissions. Do not grant access automatically.

title: Electronic signature request remains pending
content: Check recipient identity, delivery status, and signature workflow status. Draft a reminder for human review. Never sign on behalf of a user.

title: Binder synchronization has stalled
content: Compare source and destination synchronization timestamps and inspect the synchronization job status. Draft an escalation if the job has failed. Do not overwrite regulatory records.

title: Training completion not reflected in dashboard
content: Check the training completion record, course version, study assignment, and dashboard refresh timestamp. Recommend a refresh or draft an escalation when records disagree.
